# `jouet wait pr`

- **Usage:** `jouet wait pr <FLAGS> [PR]`

Wait for a PR to become mergeable, merged, approved, ready, ...

--until is one of: mergeable (keeps waiting while GitHub reports UNKNOWN; exit 1 on a conflict), merged (exit 1 if closed unmerged), closed, approved (exit 1 when changes are requested), checks-registered (any check on the head), ready (no `pr status` attention codes and no pending checks; exit 1 on conflict, checks_failing, changes_requested or unresolved_threads), any-change (the next push, check result, review, thread or state change, printed as one event), or needs-agent (see below). A conflict counts once GitHub reports it again 10s later, since right after a push it can still answer for the old head.

needs-agent waits until no check is pending and nothing has changed for --quiet-for, then exits 0 with one digest if the PR has a failed check (with its log excerpt), a conflict, or a review thread or top-level review comment posted since the wait began (--since) that is not bot noise: rate-limit and "review in progress" notices, summaries with no findings, perf reports with no regression, and bot acknowledgements on threads (--acks). A PR that settles with none of these is still watched; a merged or closed one exits 1. GitHub only. Its timeout defaults to 2h.

## Arguments
- **`[PR]`** — The PR: a number, URL, OWNER/REPO#N or branch. Defaults to the current branch's PR

## Flags
- **`--repo <OWNER/NAME>`** — The repository for a bare number or branch. Defaults to the git remote
- **`--until <CONDITION>`** — The condition to wait for
- **`--quiet-for <DUR>`** — needs-agent: how long nothing may change before the PR counts as settled (default 20m)
- **`--acks <loose|strict>`** — needs-agent: loose counts any bot reply on a thread that opens with thanks or agreement as noise; strict not when it also hedges or asks (default loose)
- **`--since <TIME>`** — needs-agent: comments posted from this time on are new: RFC 3339 or a duration ago such as 30m (default: when the wait starts). The digest prints the value for the next wait
- **`--log-lines <N>`** — needs-agent: lines of each failure log to show (default 60)
- **`--no-logs`** — needs-agent: do not fetch failure logs
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
